Size guide

Measure over a base layer. If you are between sizes, size up for layering and down for a trimmer fit.

Fit notes. Most jackets are a regular fit with room for a fleece. The Talus Down Hoodie is trim (size up to wear it over a fleece), the Cinder Insulated Parka is relaxed, and the Switchback Wind Shell is athletic.

Backpacks: torso length

Packs fit by torso length, not height. Ask a friend to measure from the bony bump at the base of your neck (the C7 vertebra) down your spine to the line between the tops of your hip bones.

PackSML
Cairn 45 Trekking Pack15–17 in17–19 in19–21 in
Long Haul Expedition PackAdjustable, fits 16–22 in torsos
Scree 28 DaypackOne size, fits 16–21 in torsos

Footwear

Footwear is listed in US men's sizes. Women: order 1.5 sizes down from your usual women's size (a women's 9 is a men's 7.5). The Ascent Mid boot runs true to size; the Scree Trail Runner runs half a size small, so size up half a size.
